item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 09/11/2026 Following the Vodafone Fiji Bulikula's 30-14 loss to the Jillaroos in the Women's Rugby League World Cup semi-final, captain Sereana Naitokatoka says they enjoyed their game against one of the best teams in the world.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 09/11/2026

Following the Vodafone Fiji Bulikula's 30-14 loss to the Jillaroos in the Women's Rugby League World Cup semi-final, captain Sereana Naitokatoka says they enjoyed their game against one of the best teams in the world.

During the post-match press conference, Naitokatoka says they had only one goal, and that was to have fun.

She says they are so blessed to be part of the World Cup, representing their nation, their families and everybody connected to them.

The 25-year-old adds that after the game, no one dropped their heads because everyone gave their all during the match.

Insert: Sereana on having fun. 9th Nov 26

Meanwhile, the Jillaroos will face the New Zealand Kiwi Ferns in the women's final at 5.10pm on Sunday.

item.title: Norman Amram and Merewalesi Kolitapa suffer defeats in Dakar
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 09/11/2026 Team Fiji boxers Norman Amran and Merewalesi Kolitapa lost their bouts this morning at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Dakar.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 09/11/2026

Team Fiji boxers Norman Amran and Merewalesi Kolitapa lost their bouts this morning at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Dakar.

Kolitapa lost to Japan's Ayano Mochii 4-1 in the women's 60kg preliminaries, while Amran lost to Jean Julian Agathe of Mauritius 5-0 in the men's 60kg preliminaries.

Meanwhile, China leads the medal tally with 11 gold, 4 silver and 1 bronze.

Japan is second with 9 gold, 3 silver and 4 bronze, while the Russian Federation is third with 6 gold and 4 silver.

The Youth Olympic Games will end this Friday.

item.title: Liverpool cruise to 3-1 victory over Crystal Palace
item.description: Liverpool secured a 3-1 victory over Crystal Palace in their Premier League clash. Liverpool led 1-0 at half-time after Alexis Mac Allister scored in the 40th minute.
item.content:encoded:
Liverpool secured a 3-1 victory over Crystal Palace in their Premier League clash.

Liverpool led 1-0 at half-time after Alexis Mac Allister scored in the 40th minute.

Florian Wirtz doubled Liverpool's lead in the 54th minute before Alexander Isak scored in the 89th minute.

Crystal Palace scored a consolation goal through Eddie Nketiah from the penalty spot in the 90th minute plus five.

Brighton and Hove Albion defeated Brentford 2-0, Bournemouth beat Ipswich Town 2-1, Sunderland secured a 1-0 win over Chelsea, while Manchester United and Aston Villa played out a 4-4 draw.

Arsenal remain top of the Premier League standings with 27 points, followed by Brighton on 22 points, Manchester City on 21, Liverpool on 18 and Chelsea on 16 points.
